gloss: one by one; one at a time

definitions.gloss: one by one; one at a time; individually; each
definitions.explanation: Indicates doing something one item at a time, distributing one per person, or progressing step by step. Formed from {一|ひと}つ (one) and ずつ (each, apiece). Expresses methodical, careful, or sequential action.

examples.japanese: {一|ひと}つずつ⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一|ひと}つずつ⟦{解決|かいけつ}して→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧いこう。
examples.english: Let's solve the problems one at a time.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一|ひと}つずつ⟦{配|くば}った→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: I handed out one sweet to each of the children.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (one) and ⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (each, apiece — a distributive particle). Part of a productive pattern: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (two at a time), ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ (three at a time), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一|ひと}つずつ⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check one by one
- {一|ひと}つずつ⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to deal with things one at a time
- {一|ひと}つずつ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: carefully, one at a time
- {一|ひと}つずつ⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed step by step

THE ずつ PATTERN:
The particle ⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧ attaches to counters and quantity words to express equal distribution or gradual progression:
- ⟦{一|いち}{枚|まい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: one sheet each
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: little by little
- ⟦{一歩|いっぽ}→一歩：08890_ippo⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: one step at a time
- ⟦{三|さん}{人|にん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: three people per group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一|いっ}{個|こ}ずつ→一個ずつ：18359_ikkozutsu⟧: one piece each — uses a different counter but the same meaning
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧: little by little — gradual rather than item-by-item
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in order, in turn — emphasizes sequence rather than quantity
